chore(deps)(deps): bump source-map-js from 1.2.1 to 1.2.4 (#162) Bumps [source-map-js](https://github.com/7rulnik/source-map-js) from 1.2.1 to 1.2.4.
Release notes

Sourced from source-map-js's releases.

v1.2.4

Index source maps

  • Fix originalPositionFor returning nulls at the first column of a section (#99)

    Reported by @​trackoor in #82.

  • Fix a section's column offset being applied to its second line instead of its first (#104)

    This affected sections with both a line and a column offset, in eachMapping, generatedPositionFor, SourceMapGenerator.fromSourceMap and SourceNode.fromStringWithSourceMap.

  • Support allGeneratedPositionsFor (#105)

    It threw TypeError: this._findSourceIndex is not a function. It now returns the same results as for the equivalent map without sections, with positions from every section that has the source. generatedPositionFor on nested index maps threw the same error and works now too.

  • Fix generatedPositionFor returning made-up positions (#115)

    It only searched the first section that listed the source, and when that section had no match, it returned the section offset added to null. It now searches all sections, so bias picks the closest mapping across them, and returns nulls when nothing matches.

  • Add computeColumnSpans (#116)

Other fixes

  • Fix generatedPositionFor, allGeneratedPositionsFor and eachMapping with ORIGINAL_ORDER throwing TypeError when a source has no mappings (#100)

    Reported by @​trackoor in #83. This is common in bundles, where a source can be listed after its code was tree-shaken away.

  • Fix allGeneratedPositionsFor returning positions that belong to a different source (#102)

  • Fix lookups throwing RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded on source maps with about 200,000 or more sources (#113)

  • Fix SourceNode#replaceRight throwing on a node without children (#114)

TypeScript

  • Fix type definitions that didn't match the runtime, without breaking changes (#117)

    • SourceMapConsumer accepts version as a number, null entries in sourcesContent, a missing names, index maps, JSON strings and the sourceMapUrl argument. Reported by @​linsk1998 in #43; a fix for sourcesContent was proposed by @​lahmatiy in #75.
    • SourceMapConsumer.fromSourceMap is declared, and allGeneratedPositionsFor takes an optional column and returns lastColumn.
    • The skipValidation and ignoreInvalidMapping options of SourceMapGenerator are typed.
    • SourceNode accepts nulls and chunk arrays in the constructor, nested arrays in add and prepend, and a RegExp or a replacer function in replaceRight.

    Return types that would need a breaking change, such as the nulls from originalPositionFor (#30), are documented in comments and left for the next major (#118).

Package

  • Set engines.node to >=6.0.0 (#97)

    The library already failed to load on older Node versions, so this only adds an install warning there.

... (truncated)
